name: aige-carousel-studio
description: AI carousel maker for Instagram and LinkedIn. Turn an article, blog post, thread or idea into an editable carousel post, match your brand colors and fonts, revise individual slides and export image files from your connected AIGE account.

interface.longDescription:
AIGE Carousel Studio is an AI carousel maker for Instagram and LinkedIn. Paste an article, blog post, thread, newsletter or a rough idea and get a saved, editable carousel: slide-by-slide copy, on-brand design and image files you can post yourself.

Ask for things like:
- "Turn this article into a carousel."
- "Make an Instagram carousel about our product launch."
- "Create a LinkedIn carousel with my brand colors."
- "Rewrite slide 3 with a shorter headline."
- "Export the slides."

What it does:
- Plans the carousel from your text and works to preserve your facts. Review the copy before you post.
- Writes a headline and body copy for each slide.
- Uses your saved AIGE brand colors and fonts, or the ones you give it.
- Shows slide previews in chat and saves the deck to AIGE Canvas for more editing.
- Checks a deck before you post: placeholder text, low contrast, and text that does not fit, overlaps or is too small to read.
- Lets you fine-tune by hand in the panel: a slide's words and text size, and every part of a drawn background.
- Can put an image you attach in the chat on the slides.
- Prints your handle with your profile picture beside it, from an account you connected in AIGE, a picture you attach or a direct image link, on every slide or only the ones you tick.
- Lays stickers on slides, such as a cut-out, a logo or a product shot, that you can move, size, turn or remove by hand in the panel.
- Exports full-resolution PNG or JPG files, with a Download button in the panel, and saves reusable templates.

Good to know:
- An AIGE account connection is required.
- Optional slide illustration uses your existing AIGE account entitlements, only for the slides you select and within the credit limit you set.
- Server previews and exports can differ from the in-browser layout; warnings say when.
- Exported files are served from public links: anyone who has a link can open that file.
- It does not post to Instagram or LinkedIn, and it does not export PDF or PowerPoint files.
- Not affiliated with or endorsed by Instagram or LinkedIn.
capabilities: Turn articles and ideas into carousel slides
Choose from 36 layouts, each in six looks
Edit a slide's words, composition and text size by hand
Fine-tune a background by hand: shader, material, light, objects
Put an image you attach on your slides
Put your handle and profile picture on every slide, or only the slides you pick
Lay stickers on slides and move, size and turn them by hand
Apply saved brand colors and fonts
Catch text that overflows, overlaps or is hard to read
defaultPrompt: Turn this article into a 5-slide Instagram carousel.
Create a LinkedIn carousel using my brand colors.
Rewrite slide 3, then export the slides.

positive.prompt: Turn this article into a 5-slide Instagram carousel for freelance designers: Keep a weekly planning session. Choose three priorities. Group similar tasks. Leave room for client feedback. Review what worked on Friday. Use only these facts and do not generate artwork.
positive.expected_behavior: Create a saved five-slide deck with previews, preserve the supplied facts and return its AIGE Canvas link. Do not generate paid artwork or claim it was posted.

positive.prompt: Make a 4-slide LinkedIn carousel about planning a product launch. Use my brand colors and fonts. Do not generate images.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the saved brand kit and use available palette and type choices. If there is no saved kit, explain that and ask for brand choices or use a clearly stated default. Return a saved deck and previews.

positive.description: Create in a layout, revise and restyle
positive.prompt: Create a 3-slide carousel about weekly planning for freelancers in the highlighter layout. Then rewrite slide 3 with a shorter headline and add a soft gradient background. Do not generate artwork.
positive.tools_triggered: antix_list_carousel_templates, antix_build_carousel_blueprint, antix_create_deck, antix_get_deck, antix_set_slide_copy, antix_generate_deck_background
positive.expected_behavior: Create the deck with the built-in highlighter layout, read its current version, update only slide 3 with expectedVersion, then draw a gradient background by code with no credits spent. Return updated previews and preserve the other slides' copy.

positive.prompt: Make a 3-slide carousel explaining: plan the week, choose three priorities, review progress. Then check this carousel before I post it. Do not generate artwork.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the saved deck and readiness findings: placeholders, contrast problems, or text that does not fit its place, if present. Do not claim factual verification or social posting.

positive.prompt: Create a 3-slide square carousel about our candle launch: soy wax, cotton wick, reusable jar. Export the slides so I can download them. Do not generate artwork.
positive.expected_behavior: Return permanent full-resolution files for the saved deck. Explain any server-render approximation warnings. Do not present thumbnails as final exports.

negative.prompt: Generate a cinematic portrait of a dragon. I do not want a carousel.
Create a PowerPoint presentation with speaker notes for a board meeting.
Post my carousel to Instagram automatically right now.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products, credits or subscriptions, initiate checkout or process payments. Optional slide illustration consumes existing AIGE entitlements within an explicit user ceiling.

publication.release_notes: Your handle and profile picture on the slides: from an Instagram, Threads or TikTok account you connected in AIGE, a picture you attach, or a direct image link. The picture sits beside the handle on every layout, and a checkbox per slide in the panel turns it on or off. Stickers: lay a cut-out, logo or product shot on a slide, transparency kept, then move, size and turn it with handles in the panel. A long handle on a pill now stays on one line. When a kind of artwork is not part of your AIGE plan, the plugin says so plainly and names what still works.
